notes.title: HOLA, AMIGOS! Meet version 1.06!
notes.content:
You waited and we released a big update! 
The widget has become much more convenient.
What's new:

 ¡Spanish language!
 New features in the tray
 Window memory
 Compact form
 Docking over all windows
 Hidden launch without indication on Steam
 Several more bugs fixed


 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34595505/e76db40c8e251bc011adf2931e442fffb360197f.png 

Hope you enjoy!
As usual, write your wishes in the comments!

notes.title: Upgrade to version 1.05
notes.content:
Good news, Everyone!
We have updated our application and are happy to share it with you.

    Added multilanguage
    Fixed some bugs

Write in your reviews what other languages you would like to see.

Stay tuned and thanks for choosing our app!
